merge sample psi tables 

load packages
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(optparse)
  library(dplyr)
  library(duckplyr)
  library(dbplyr)
})
```


read in file paths

```{r read_files}
## Directories ##
# find project root to access separate results dir
repo_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::is_git_root)

# result directories
results_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "results")
compendium_results_dir <- file.path(results, "merged_shiba")
version_dir <- file.path(compendium_results_dir, "v1.1.0_two_sample")
psi_dir <- file.path(version_dir, "sample_psi")

# sample sheet dir
config_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "config")

# merged psi table output dir
output_merged <- file.path(compendium_results_dir, "merged_psi")

## Files ##

# sample sheet file with sample names
samples_file <- file.path(config_dir, "two_sample_merge_samples.tsv")

# read in sample sheet and create list of samples from samples column
samples <- readr::read_tsv(samples_file, col_types = list(.default = "c")) |>
  dplyr::pull(sample) |>
  as.list()

# define list of PSI results files corresponding to event types quantified by Shiba bulk analysis
psi_file_list <- c(
  se = "PSI_SE.txt",
  afe = "PSI_AFE.txt",
  ale = "PSI_ALE.txt",
  five = "PSI_FIVE.txt",
  three = "PSI_THREE.txt",
  mse = "PSI_MSE.txt",
  mxe = "PSI_MXE.txt",
  ri = "PSI_RI.txt"
)

# make sample psi table paths
sample_paths <- file.path(
  psi_dir,
  samples
)

# create output directory if it does not exist
if (!dir.exists(output_merged)) {
  dir.create(output_merged, recursive = TRUE)
}

```

Read in psi files

```{r}
# Make function for reading all PSI tables for a sample (or set of samples run together)
read_psi <- function(psi_path, psi_files = psi_file_list) {
  # returns a data frame with the following columns: pos_id, gene_id, label, event_type, sample, psi
  # construct file path for event type
  file_paths <- file.path(psi_path, psi_files)
  # name each PSI table file path by event type
  names(file_paths) <- names(psi_files)

  # read in files
  purrr::map(file_paths, \(file) {
    readr::read_tsv(file, col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c")) |>
      # select for columns that will be used downstream in analysis so all dataframes have uniform column names
      dplyr::select(pos_id, gene_id, label, contains("_PSI")) |>
      # transform so we get a long table of PSI values for each event type, with one row per position and sample
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = contains("_PSI"),
        names_to = "sample",
        values_to = "psi",
        values_transform = as.numeric
      )
  }) |>
    # merge individual event type PSI tables to get one PSI table per sample
    dplyr::bind_rows(.id = "event_type")
}
```
